featured_reviews.name: Siddharth Naidu
featured_reviews.review_text:
A LANGUAGE OF UNKNOWN

They stood there, locked in a quiet battle of words, the young man brimming with an almost childlike enthusiasm, trying to justify yet another book purchase as if the turning of the calendar was some grand occasion...His companion, half amused, half exasperated, reminded him of the small fortune he had already spent, her voice carrying the gentle authority of someone who knew his habits too well...He clung to a Batman comic like a talisman, only for her to sigh wasn’t two enough? As if the world of Batman could ever be contained in mere numbers...Their conversation wove through genres, shifting from playful to passionate, the air between them charged with something deeper than books a shared language, a quiet understanding and giggles...I stood there, an unnoticed observer, drawn into their orbit, watching love manifest not in grand gestures but in the simple intimacy of knowing each other’s obsessions and spending time quality time...Perhaps I should move along, leave them to their world, but for a moment, it was enough just to witness,just to admire...

In this fascinating guide, you can discover what your sun sign says about you, who you are most compatible with romantically, & how you can progress in life with insights from the heavens above. More advanced ideas regarding aspects such as Mercury Retrograde, Moon Signs & other astrological terms are explained fully & permit the reader to begin their journey into this lifelong passion.

• Descriptions of all 12 signs

She presents each threatened species in a traditionally religious form—the icon—to illustrate its true significance.

Uniquely supported by QR codes leading to the websites of conservation organisations working to protect each species & its habitat, this deck inspires contemplation, empathy, & meaningful action to enact personal & planetary healing.

Others know they have a gift but are unclear how to develop or articulate that gift. The 11 Spiritual Roles of the Soul, by celebrated author & channel Sara Landon, offers readers a profound & life-changing perspective on why we are here on Earth at this time.

In this book, The Council—an energetic presence of non-physical beings—reveals the 11 spiritual roles of the soul: healer, messenger, seer, transformer, dreamer, visualizer, wayshower, connector, uplifter, coder, & guide. 

After understanding their spiritual role, readers will learn:
• How the 11 spiritual roles relate to their life’s purpose
• How to use their spiritual gifts to enhance & expand every area of their lives
• Why stepping into their spiritual role right now is so important
• How they fit into the Great Awakening of humanity occurring at this time
• Daily practices for embodying their spiritual roles

By aligning with their spiritual roles, individuals can uncover their true purpose, develop confidence in their unique gifts, & navigate their path with renewed clarity & joy.

In Master Your Time, Master Your Life, internationally acclaimed productivity expert & bestselling author Brian Tracy presents a brilliant new approach to time management that will help you gain control of your time & accomplish far more, faster & more easily than you ever thought possible.

Drawing on the latest research in productivity science & Tracy’s decades of expertise, this breakthrough program allocates time into ten categories of priority—including strategic planning/goal setting, people & family, income improvement, rest/relaxation, & even creative time—and reveals the best techniques for focusing on each effectively. By thoughtfully applying the principles in Master Your Time, Master Your Life, you’ll not only achieve greater results & reach your goals more quickly & successfully, you’ll also have more time to devote to what you truly love.

Board-certified sleep doctor Benjamin Long offers hope for anyone who needs help falling asleep or quieting the anxieties of the day while longing for rest.

Who has not experienced a dog who just won’t stop barking or a cat that seems to strike out without apparent reason? Relief might be at hand with the simple yet effective point-tapping practices of the Emotional Freedom Technique (EFT), which provide an excellent hands-on tool for treating behavioural, emotional, & health challenges in animals.

In this practical guide, expert animal communicator & healer Joan Ranquet shows how to apply this energetic bodywork method on animals such as dogs, cats, or horses. As you tap on certain acupressure points with a specific intention in mind, the animal will experience energetic release on the levels of mind, body, emotions, & spirit. For easy access, you will find maps clearly illustrating the specific EFT acupressure points on dogs, cats, & horses. In addition, Joan provides sample point sequences & intention scripts geared to specific ailments, conditions, & behavioural challenges, as well as end-of-life care. Targeted to work with & relieve difficult emotions, the points used in EFT sequences each have a feel-good aspect to them, either a calming or releasing effect, & the scripts work to help break up old behavioural or emotional patterning.

Presenting a way to cut straight to the energetic source of the problems the animal experiences & provide relief even if you don’t know the cause of their pain, this guide will help you not only become closer to your animal companions but also improve their well-being as well as your own.

We all want to be happier, but our brains often get in the way. When we’re too stuck in our heads, we obsess over our inadequacies, compare ourselves with others & fail to see the good in our lives.

In The Science of Happiness, world-leading psychologist & happiness expert Bruce Hood demonstrates that the key to happiness is not self-care but connection. He presents seven simple but life-changing lessons to break negative thought patterns & reconnect with the things that really matter.

• Alter Your Ego
• Avoid Isolation
• Reject Negative Comparisons
• Become More Optimistic
• Control Your Attention
• Connect With Others
• Get Out of Your Own Head

Grounded in decades of studies in neuroscience & developmental psychology, this book tells a radical new story about the roots of wellbeing & the obstacles that lie in our path. With clear, practical takeaways throughout, Professor Hood demonstrates how we can all harness the findings of this science to rewire our thinking & transform our lives.

Drinking sufficient quantities of water is a necessity for optimal physical functioning, but it can also play a major role in the prevention & treatment of many diseases. Chronic fatigue, depression, eczema, rheumatism, gastric disorders, high or low blood pressure, high cholesterol, obesity, & urinary infections are but a few of the many disorders that can result from not drinking enough water—and which can be treated by raising our intake of this vital liquid.

The physical assaults that our bodies endure from pollution, stress, overly rich & processed foods (often containing too much salt), & alcohol & tobacco have dramatically increased our daily need for water over what our ancestors required. Christopher Vasey explains not only why water is so essential to our health but also what quantities we should drink & when. He also discusses the qualities of different types of water & demonstrates which will best address certain conditions. In addition, he provides 10 water cures that will rehydrate the deepest levels of the body, remove toxins, & restore vital minerals.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Gandhi Book Centre is a long-standing bookstore in Bhaji Gulli, Grant Road, Mumbai that has been operating for nearly fifty years.

It is a niche and focused space, primarily dedicated to literature on Mahatma Gandhi and Vinoba Bhave.

The store houses a wide collection of books that explore Mahatma Gandhi’s life, philosophy, and contributions to India’s freedom movement. From autobiographical works to compilations of his writings and speeches, the range is quite extensive. Multiple editions and languages are available, making it accessible to a wider audience.

On my visit, I was recommended a copy of The Story of My Experiments with Truth, which is one of the most well-known accounts of Gandhi’s life and thought process. It is a work that reflects not just events of his life, but the process of self-examination behind it.

The person at the store was helpful, knowledgeable, and willing to guide based on interest.

It’s worth noting that this is a bookstore and not a lending library. All books are for purchase.

In a time when historical narratives are often debated and reinterpreted, spaces like this serve as valuable repositories of original writings and documented thought.

Gandhi’s philosophy of truth / satyagraha and non-violence (ahimsa), along with movements such as non-cooperation and swadeshi, played a significant role in mobilizing people against British rule. His writings, many of which are compiled in the Collected Works of Mahatma Gandhi (spanning a 100 volumes), provide detailed insight into his methods and thinking.

For anyone interested in understanding Gandhi’s philosophy of non-violence and truth, or exploring the works of Vinoba Bhave, this bookstore is well worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: Anil Bishnoi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ashish Book Centre, tucked away near the bustling CSMT Railway Station in Fort, is nothing short of a paradise for true book lovers. In a city that’s always racing against time, this bookstore feels like a quiet, timeless refuge where stories patiently wait to be discovered.

What makes Ashish Book Centre truly special is its incredible collection. From rare second-hand classics and academic textbooks to novels, competitive exam guides, and out-of-print treasures—you never know what gem you’ll stumble upon. Browsing through the shelves feels like going on a literary treasure hunt, and every visit brings a new surprise.

The owners and staff are extremely knowledgeable and helpful. They don’t just sell books; they understand them. Whether you walk in with a specific title in mind or just a vague idea of what you want to read, they guide you with genuine enthusiasm and honesty. Their passion for books is infectious.

Another big win is the affordability. Ashish Book Centre proves that great reading doesn’t have to be expensive. Students, avid readers, and collectors alike will appreciate the fair pricing and excellent condition of the books.

Located in the heart of Fort, just a stone’s throw from CSMT, it’s incredibly convenient and perfectly placed for a spontaneous visit after work or college. Despite the chaos outside, the store offers a calm, almost nostalgic vibe that reminds you why physical bookstores still matter.

If you love books, value knowledge, or simply enjoy the charm of old-school bookstores, Ashish Book Centre is an absolute must-visit. It’s not just a shop—it’s an experience, a legacy, and a reminder that the love for reading is very much alive in Mumbai. 📚

I liked that there were options at different price points. You can browse without feeling rushed, and it doesn’t feel too cramped even when there are people around. The coffee inside makes it a good place to pause for a bit, read a few pages, or just sit quietly.

We were actually looking for Third Wave Coffee and found it on the map. When we reached the building, there was no sign of it anywhere. Nothing in the elevator either, so we were a bit confused at first

Overall, it’s a good bookstore to visit in Juhu if you enjoy browsing and don’t mind spending some time there. Just know that Third Wave Coffee is inside Crosswords and not a separate outlet, which can be confusing at first.
